observation.command: cd /workspace/project && UA="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"; for u in "https://dash.allmodels.io/api/free-credits/claim" "https://dash.allmodels.io/api/me/free-credits/claim" "https://allmodels.io/api/free-credits/claim" "https://dash.allmodels.io/api/me/free-credits"; do printf "%-50s " "$u"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET=%{http_code} " --max-time 20 -A "$UA" "$u"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "POST=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 -A "$UA" -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}' "$u"; done
